name: idle-agent-tools
description: Idle agent tools: a shared record of work for coding agents, and a multi-agent development workflow on top of it.

plugins.name: idle-tasks
plugins.description: The record of work for agents: tasks that nest into trees, and decisions. Four operations over MCP and the idle CLI; the system runs your project's checks when a task is submitted. PGlite locally, any Postgres when shared. Bring your own workflow.

plugins.name: idle-skills
plugins.description: An interview turns a dropped task into a goal and a plan you own; a planner breaks it into goals, builders and reviewers work them, and you contradict what is not done. 15 skills + 3 personas. Works on idle-tasks.
